children: Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) has signed a greenfield project for a 300-key Taj hotel in Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu, strengthening its presence in the state. The Taj Rameswaram will be developed across 70 acres in phases and will include a wellness centre.

The resort will feature two speciality restaurants, a bar lounge and a pool bar. Facilities for meetings and social gatherings will include banquet and convention spaces and meeting rooms. Recreational amenities will comprise a swimming pool, fitness centre and a spa with multiple treatment rooms.

Suma Venkatesh, Executive Vice President - Real Estate & Development, IHCL, said, “Rameswaram is among India’s most prominent spiritual destinations, attracting travellers from across the country and overseas. With growing infrastructure and improving connectivity, the destination presents significant potential for religious, spiritual, leisure and MICE tourism. We are delighted to partner with Setupuram Hotels & Resorts Private Limited for this project and bring the Taj experience to Rameswaram.”

Located on the mainland with direct beach access and connectivity to NH87, the resort will be positioned near the Pamban Bridge and the Ramanathaswamy Temple, one of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites and among the twelve Jyotirlingas. Rameswaram is connected to regional centres including Madurai and Tiruchirappalli and is undergoing infrastructure development aimed at improving accessibility.
The expansion of NH87 to a four-lane highway, redevelopment of the railway station and proposed domestic airport are expected to support connectivity to the destination.

Rajesh Jograj Bafna, Director, Setupuram Hotels & Resorts Private Limited, said, “We are delighted to partner with IHCL to bring the Taj brand to Rameswaram. This partnership marks an important milestone in our hospitality journey and we look forward to contributing to the region’s tourism potential.”
